claims.hypothesis: Does asymmetric external illumination explain the methanol asymmetry?
claims.experiment: Dust temperature maps, RT model and equilibrium abundance model
claims.result: Model gives east:west peak ratio ~4:3 versus observed >=10:1
claims.finding: Illumination contributes but cannot alone explain the contrast; enhanced desorption on the shaded side is needed

evidence.quote: the stark contrast observed in H-MM1 is hard to explain without assuming enhanced desorption on the shaded side

claims.hypothesis: Is the bright methanol zone a shear layer with Kelvin-Helmholtz instability driving grain-grain desorption?
claims.experiment: Morphology, Brunt-Väisälä and Richardson analysis, desorption rate estimates
claims.result: Shear-induced collision desorption rate ~4e-15 mol-1 s-1 comparable to other mechanisms
claims.finding: Proposed as a plausible mechanism, not proven

evidence.quote: We suggest that in this zone, methanol and sulphur are released as a result of grain-grain collisions induced by shear vorticity.
